rows: CodeRabbit Review Challenges every change before the merge, ensuring only the best code lands in your codebase.
AI Code Review before the PR in CLI, IDE, and coding-agent loops
AI Code Review at the PR Plain language summary & walkthrough with described changes, diagrams, and related/linked issues
CodeRabbit Chat ask questions, understand recommendations, and provide feedback to improve future performance
Learnings Context captured from prior PRs, issues, and guidelines. Viewable/editable by you, applied by CodeRabbit in all activities
Autofix One-click code changes for unresolved findings
Slop Detection Flag low-quality AI-generated PRs
Pre-Merge Checks Enforce quality gates and your custom requirements before pull requests are merged
Unit Tests Generate comprehensive tests automatically for PRs, including edge cases and error conditions
Finishing Touches Resolve conflicts, simplify code, and generate docstrings with a single click
Post-Merge Actions Run automated follow-up work, including changelog updates, tickets, and notifications
Linked Repositories How many repos CodeRabbit works across
Review Velocity Included PR reviews per developer each hour (additional reviews available on consumption with the ability to cap budgets)
CodeRabbit AI Engineer Trigger the CodeRabbit cloud-based coding agent to execute changes, refactoring, or custom final touches without leaving the PR
CodeRabbit Triage Ranks your PR queue by value, impact, and risk, so you spend your time on the right work and ship fast.
Prioritized PR Queue Cross-repository queue of open PRs, organized by value, urgency, and next required action with custom filters and saved views
Review Guidance identifies risk, effort, impact, and candidates to be closed
Actions Review, repair, reassign, merge, close, and follow a pull request from the Triage queue
Triage in Slack Get your queue as a scheduled digest, send reviewer requests to others, and approve or close a PR in Slack
Security Risk Security-informed prioritization of PRs
CodeRabbit Explain Makes every change understood in extensive detail so you can accurately judge code before it ships.
Change Stack Review workspace that turns a PR into a structured, navigable artifact you can read, question, and act on
Semantic Diff Explains the actual structure of code changes, highlighting exact edits, code movement, and functional changes
Findings Read what CodeRabbit found in a change, judge how ready it is to merge, and decide what to fix first
CodeRabbit Chat Ask questions about changes, files, or code
Blast Radius : Opens in a new tab Identifies and maps the downstream reach and impact of a pull request beyond its directly modified lines of code
Architecture Impact Describes which system-level responsibilities and relationships have changed and how
CodeRabbit AI Engineer Trigger the CodeRabbit cloud-based coding agent for further analysis or to execute changes for you.
CodeRabbit Secure Analyzes every line of code and monitors every change, so you understand your risks for total code security.
Security Code Review Static analysis, secrets, dependency, and infrastructure checks
Continuous Security Review with attack-surface visibility
PR Security Review with status, severity, exploitability, and reachability context
Security Architecture Review Assesses the systemic and structural consequences of PRs, tracing changes across trust boundaries, sensitive operations, and downst
Security Blast Radius Map how a PR changes dependencies, downstream consumers, tests, and security-relevant paths
Deep Scan Find exploitable vulnerabilities and exposed secrets across committed source code and infrastructure configuration
Enterprise Controls Tailor CodeRabbit to fit your organization's specific standards, expectations, and needs so that it performs like your best engineer.
Usage controls and monthly spending caps
MCP connections to external tools and context
Multi-org administration and enforced workspace policies
Custom roles and permissions, SSO, and audit logs
API access, including review and MCP usage metrics
Support SLA, dedicated customer success, & technical enablement
Custom deployment options, including self-hosting and company-selected SaaS regions
Custom purchasing options; including marketplaces, vendor security reviews, and negotiated contracts
